title: Nodules, masses, infection and congenital lesions

steps.tx: Standardised surveillance protocols avoid unnecessary radiation exposure while capturing early malignancy. Under the **Fleischner Society** 2017 guidelines, incidental solid **pulmonary nodules** measuring under 6 mm in low-risk individuals aged 35 years or older require no routine computed tomography follow-up examination.

steps.tx: Severely immunocompromised patients with profound neutropenia are highly vulnerable to opportunistic fungal invasion. In this population, **angioinvasive aspergillosis** classically manifests as a focal consolidation surrounded by a rim of ground-glass attenuation known as the **CT halo sign**, reflecting ischaemic alveolar haemorrhage.

steps.tx: Pre-existing structural lung cavities provide a nidus for fungal colonization. Colonization by Aspergillus species generates an **aspergilloma**, which presents as a mobile intracavitary fungal ball capped by air on computed tomography, displaying the classic **Monod sign** or air crescent sign that shifts position on decubitus views.

steps.tx: Congenital bronchopulmonary malformations involve anomalous systemic arterialization of non-functioning lung tissue. An extralobar **pulmonary sequestration** is enveloped within its own independent visceral pleura, is supplied by an aberrant **systemic artery** from the aorta, and characteristically drains into the azygos or hemiazygos veins.

steps.tx: In contrast to extralobar lesions, an **intralobar** **pulmonary sequestration** develops within the native pulmonary parenchyma. It is enveloped by the normal visceral pleura, occurs predominantly within the posterior basal segment of the left lower lobe in 65% of cases, and characteristically drains via pulmonary veins into the left atrium.

steps.tx: Anterior mediastinal compartment lesions follow distinct anatomical rules. A **thymoma** represents the most common anterior mediastinal mass in adults, typically manifesting on computed tomography as a well-demarcated, smooth or lobulated solid soft-tissue mass that is closely associated with **myasthenia gravis** in 30% to 50% of patients.

steps.tx: Asbestos exposure predisposes to diffuse pleural malignancy. Classical malignant **pleural mesothelioma** exhibits **circumferential**, nodular pleural thickening exceeding 1 cm that encases the hemithorax, preferentially involves the mediastinal pleura, and causes volume contraction of the affected 1 hemithorax on computed tomography.
steps.say: Asbestos exposure predisposes to diffuse pleural malignancy. Classical malignant pleural mesothelioma exhibits circumferential, nodular pleural thickening exceeding 1 centimetre that encases the hemithorax, preferentially involves the mediastinal pleura, and causes volume contraction of the affected 1 hemithorax on computed tomography.

steps.tx: Subpleural parenchymal consolidation patterns yield valuable diagnostic clues in atypical pulmonary infections and organizing pneumonia. The **reversed halo sign**, or atoll sign, consists of a central zone of ground-glass attenuation encircled by a complete or crescentic rim of dense consolidation, classically seen in **cryptogenic organizing pneumonia**.
